confidence_notes: Food anchors use Alanya's October 2026 Numbeo averages converted approximately from TRY to USD, so the July pricing window and conversion add uncertainty. Cocktail and wine estimates use their local price relationship to beer and limited Alanya menu checks. Lodging figures draw on Alanya-wide aggregates; hostel choices are few and hotel prices vary sharply by season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Alanya-specific prices and lodging data are the main basis. Antalya provides a nearby regional comparison for meals, but its prices were not substituted.
